exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-20T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix attach-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: attach-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card create 'Attachment origin'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt

# Standard input requires a portable presentation filename.
! exec card attachment add -
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/stdin-name-error.txt

# The workflow script retains random attachment handles between process calls.
exec sh attachment-workflow.sh
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/workflow.txt
! stderr .

-- attachment-workflow.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

add_output=$(card attachment add report.txt --issue attach-1)
attachment_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$add_output" | sed -n '1p')
case "$attachment_id" in
  att_[a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7]) ;;
  *) echo "invalid attachment ID: $attachment_id" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$add_output" | sed -n '2p')" = "[report.txt](attachment:$attachment_id)" ]
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$add_output" | sed -n '3p')" = "![report.txt](attachment:$attachment_id)" ]

card attachment show "$attachment_id" >show.out
grep -F "Attachment $attachment_id" show.out >/dev/null
grep -F 'Name: report.txt' show.out >/dev/null
grep -F 'Lifecycle: active' show.out >/dev/null
grep -F 'Availability: present_unverified' show.out >/dev/null

card attachment list --issue attach-1 >list.out
grep -F 'ID' list.out >/dev/null
grep -F "$attachment_id" list.out >/dev/null
grep -F 'report.txt' list.out >/dev/null

card attachment get "$attachment_id" downloaded.txt >get.out
cmp report.txt downloaded.txt
cmp get.out golden/get.txt

if card attachment get "$attachment_id" downloaded.txt >overwrite.out 2>overwrite.err; then
  echo 'attachment get unexpectedly overwrote its output' >&2
  exit 1
fi
[ ! -s overwrite.out ]
cmp overwrite.err golden/overwrite-error.txt

card attachment get "$attachment_id" downloaded.txt --force >force.out
cmp report.txt downloaded.txt
cmp force.out golden/get.txt

stdin_output=$(card attachment add - --name stdin.txt <stdin.txt)
stdin_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$stdin_output" | sed -n '1p')
case "$stdin_id" in
  att_[a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7][a-z2-7]) ;;
  *) echo "invalid attachment ID: $stdin_id" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$stdin_output" | sed -n '2p')" = "[stdin.txt](attachment:$stdin_id)" ]
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$stdin_output" | sed -n '3p')" = "![stdin.txt](attachment:$stdin_id)" ]
card attachment get "$stdin_id" stdin-downloaded.txt >/dev/null
cmp stdin.txt stdin-downloaded.txt

card attachment remove "$attachment_id" >remove.out
grep -F "removed $attachment_id" remove.out >/dev/null
card attachment show "$attachment_id" >removed.out
grep -F 'Lifecycle: removed' removed.out >/dev/null

card attachment gc --dry-run >gc-dry-run.out
cmp gc-dry-run.out golden/gc-dry-run.txt
card attachment gc >gc.out
cmp gc.out golden/gc.txt

printf '%s\n' \
  'file upload, metadata, and download passed' \
  'stdin upload passed' \
  'overwrite protection and force passed' \
  'removal and collection passed'

-- report.txt --
bridge report
-- stdin.txt --
sensor log
-- golden/create.txt --
attach-1
-- golden/stdin-name-error.txt --
error: attachment add: --name is required when reading standard input
-- golden/get.txt --
wrote downloaded.txt (14 bytes)
-- golden/overwrite-error.txt --
error: write attachment output "downloaded.txt": open downloaded.txt: file exists
-- golden/gc-dry-run.txt --
Dry run: true
Expired staging: 0 items, 0 bytes
Orphan blobs: 0 items, 0 bytes
Integrity problems: 0
-- golden/gc.txt --
Dry run: false
Expired staging: 0 items, 0 bytes
Orphan blobs: 0 items, 0 bytes
Integrity problems: 0
-- golden/workflow.txt --
file upload, metadata, and download passed
stdin upload passed
overwrite protection and force passed
removal and collection passed
